**Target:** Hightouch — Software Engineer, AI Agents

## Substantive improvements

- Moved product/backend delivery and data modeling ahead of peripheral infrastructure so the opening reads as an AI-product engineer rather than solely an internal tooling specialist.
- Distinguished typed MCP planning, transactional recovery, and real product interfaces as separate architectural contributions rather than seven variations on 'built agent tools'.
- Restored evidence of an actual data-centric REST product and user-facing React/PostgreSQL platform.

## Unresolved qualification gaps and interview risks

- No supported direct experience with marketing data agents, production customer-facing LLM pipelines, customer experimentation metrics, or specific model/provider integrations.
- No measured production AI-agent revenue or conversion lift; role-specific product sense must be established in interviews.
- Published wide compensation band spans below current compensation; negotiate cash/recurring equity carefully.

## Hiring-manager assessment

Credible for backend/agent architecture with demonstrated product-building breadth, but materially less directly proven for marketing-data/LLM customer products than specialist applicants. Interview prospects depend heavily on demonstrating product sense, data-agent system design and rapid application learning.

## Quality-assurance status

- Reviewed semantic entailment, factual ownership, role dates, seniority, terminology and target-specific differentiation against the indicated knowledge records.
- Single-column Markdown, standard headings, concise bullets and ordinary links; no tables, graphics or fake ATS scores.
- **Not yet run:** repository-wide `python3 scripts/career.py validate`, automated `build`/`audit` claim-manifest generation, DOCX/PDF rendering or visual/page-break QA. These require the full working checkout and tooling.

- Original job pages are dynamic; employer postings, compensation and hiring status should be reconfirmed when submitting.
